items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: When I came back, I went to Celestine.

ctx.x: later though? Amazon. As you like it? As you like it and that AZ. It was right there, that AZ. Amazon never did come out. Was Schatz with the regular band or was he just hired for the... Well that was before the band split up. Oh yeah. And then he went over? I went with Celestine. He was risen. I was in Jacksonville, Florida. When I came back, I went to Celestine. See there's uh... those first four records, that was a full tuxedo band. And those other three records, those records were made after the band had…
Had you ever made any other records with any other band besides Celestine? Yeah. With the White Carnations.
